visualize_depth_tensor: visualize a depth tensor as a color-mapped image using OpenCV COLORMAP_JET
compute_ssim: compute the SSIM similarity metric between two RGB images using Gaussian filtering
compute_lpips: compute the LPIPS perceptual similarity metric between two RGB images using Alex or VGG
convert_sdf_to_ply: convert a 3D SDF tensor to a PLY mesh file using marching cubes
apply_positional_encoding: apply Fourier positional encoding to 3D coordinates with configurable frequency bands
